name: Thư tình bay qua phố biển
notes: A love letter delivered by broom over a little harbour town at golden hour (the shared couple of templates/_models, Grab3D's Casual Man and Casual Woman, CC0, in their own clothes, she fitted at .945 of his height; her witch's hat with its two ribbons, the town, the lighthouse, the broom, the envelope and the painted sky are built in story.js). Stop 1: the town pops up out of the card, a young witch hops onto her broom by the night post office, rises in a swirl of sparkles and banks round over the rooftops while her sweetheart waves from his roof terrace; an airmail label with the card's first words (slot note1) comes up and gets its postmark. Stop 2: she swoops low past the viewer, lands on his terrace, steps off and hands him the letter; he opens it, the heart seal pops and the card's photo rises out of the envelope with its caption (slot caption). Stop 3: dusk falls and the photo is pegged on his washing line; they hop onto the broom one after the other and draw a heart of sparkles in the sky while the lighthouse sweeps; they hover over the town, his arms round her, and a banner with the last words (slot note2) rises. The next tap opens the letter. The act is the shared templates/_acts/lovestory.js; this card's own moves are in story.js.
